title: Can Adding More AI Agents Reduce Performance?
facebook: Here's something that might surprise you about AI tools: adding more helpers doesn't always help. Research shows that past a certain point, too many AI agents start contradicting each other and performance drops. The takeaway? Sometimes one solid tool beats several. https://aiworldhq.com/article/why-adding-more-ai-agents-can-actually-make-things-worse #AI #Productivity
